review_notes.evidence: All 28 printed card portions and source-specific routes read in native crops. AG/AQ/AS/AL UR and BC✲UR; AH/AJ/AR/AT OR. AH OR independently confirmed from the full source after coordinator review; AH-function-full-native.png. AL UR is best resolved in carry-letters-native.png; the narrow contact catches the incoming wire over its top. SUM18 row44 branches at c92 to BG U10 and descends c136 to AY J10. SUM14 lower AV D06 drives AX G12; AW J13/U08 form an isolated input jumper crossing the SUM14 trunk at c138 r54 and r55 without printed diamonds. The upper AV D06 starred route is separate. AS lower pin is U07, resolved in upper-feedback-native.png. A1 confirms card portions, not these local electrical connections. Extended gate input rails159/160/158/153/154; AW output crosses AX rail without joining. Five-reference output continuations have the printed second diamond and connected second-row corner. Ordinary banks retained. Native source and rendered halves reviewed; independent coordinator acceptance pending.
